name: Fade to Black
source:
Well, if this is not a dream I was completely alone in a strange place without a single idea on how to go home.
The phrase the little girl said echoed in my mind.

"If you didn't wish for it, you wouldn't be here~ hehe."

And if that was true... Do I even want to go back?
translation:
如果这不是梦，那我就是真的独自困在了这个陌生的地方，对如何回家毫无头绪。
小女孩说过的话，在脑海里回响。

“如果不是你自己希望来这里，你就不会在这儿啦，嘿嘿。”

如果那是真的……我真的还想回去吗？
